summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 10, 2026, reporting its net revenue for May 2026. The filing is a routine monthly operational update by a foreign private issuer, disclosing consolidated revenue of approximately NT$416.98 billion for May, up 1.5% month-over-month and 30.1% year-over-year. It also includes standard disclosures on funds lent to other parties, endorsements and guarantees, and financial derivative transactions. This constitutes ordinary business reporting and does not reflect any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other corporate event. No terms, recommendations, or structural changes are present.
